CanBeGeneratedInCombat.issue: Closed 2026-07-31 (tier-2 campaign): Flag pair corrected against the C#, read line-by-line for all six cards: none overrides CanBeGeneratedByModifiers or CanonicalKeywords, so the sim's is_playable=False AND can_be_generated_by_modifiers=False were BOTH wrong and can_be_generated_in_combat=False was missing. These Statuses are playable no-effect cards in the game (the shape the sim already models for card/beckon). LIVENESS CORRECTION: the recorded dormancy checked only pool_card_ids and curse_pool_ids, but a THIRD consumer exists -- transform_options_in_combat's STATUS branch, reached by ported Entropy. Pre-fix this genuinely leaked all four bad cards as transform options for every reachable Status card, including frantic_escape, which The Insatiable really does put in piles (test_hive.py::TestTheInsatiable). Reproduced by execution by both the implementer and the task reviewer, and closed by the same fix -- the STATUS branch's filter is the correct mirror of GetFilteredTransformationOptions (CardFactory.cs:189-203). So this mechanism was recorded DORMANT but was reachable; it is fixed, not merely re-argued. Pinned in test/test_card_generation_pool.py.  The text it replaced read: `public override bool CanBeGeneratedInCombat => false` (MindRot.cs:14) has no counterpart; the sim leaves `can_be_generated_in_combat` True and turns off a different flag that MindRot.cs does not override. Identical to card/disintegration's and card/frantic_escape's entries and carrying the same verdict (rule 3). DORMANT both ways: `pool_card_ids()` (IRONCLAD_POOL) holds no Status cards, and the random-CURSE pool holds no Status-rarity cards either.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py`) now short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check, returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`; the record's `:100-103` cite is one line of decompiler drift), which runs before any local or global modifier. All 29 unplayable curse/status/quest cards now set `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (previously 0), each verified individually against its own C# `base(-1, CardType.X, ...)` constructor -- no exceptions, no ascension-gated cost variant. Readers audit (every non-cards/ `energy_cost` hit read in context): combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)` -- the sim's analogue of C#'s `Math.Max(0, GetWithModifiers(...))` in `GetAmountToSpend`/`GetResolved` (`CardEnergyCost.cs:134-141`) -- so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are byte-for-byte unchanged. The three previously-known readers (`relics/mummified_hand.py`, `potions.py` TouchOfInsanity, `cards/event_cards.py` Enlightenment) remain correct, confirmed by unit tests. NOT closed here: `selectors.py`'s `scripted_card_selector` 'to_draw_top' purpose (Headbutt/Thinking Ahead) ranks by raw `card.energy_cost` unclamped -- a sim-only heuristic with no C# analogue; a curse in a Headbutt-eligible discard pile now ranks below-cost instead of tying at 0. No test exercises it; filed in GAP-QUEUE.md's 'Named work with no entry of its own'. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests).  The text it replaced read: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests.

Self-target, self-applier, amount 1. `KnowledgeDemon.IChoosable` is an interface rather than a CardModel override, so the harness's `public override` scan does not enumerate it -- added by hand.
